text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, Gold Ship suddenly
dragged me to a movie theater.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By coincidence, Mejiro McQueen happened to be there as well—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hyahohooy! Now, which one should I watch!
You guys better pick one within the next 10,800 seconds too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What could you possibly need three whole hours for...?
More importantly, please lower your voice a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry to ask, but could you
buy some popcorn for me? As large as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As long as that's placed on her lap,
Gold Ship-san will stay quiet throughout the movie.
choice_data_list: You're really used to this, aren't you...
You seem pretty used to this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We watch movies together all the time, you know.
Mac-chan just loves me thaaat muchâª

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, every single time,
you're the one who comes after me, you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Last time, when I suddenly realized you were sitting in a seat that was supposed to be empty, I nearly screamed...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...McQueen. If you're gonna call yourself a movie lover, you gotta remember at least this much.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: “Please remain quiet until the credits finish rolling,” got it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Quiet down this instant!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, time to decide what to watch!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The heartwarming sports drama, "Throw Down, Ebisu-ko!"
or the pulse-pounding action flick, "JAM: The Miraculous Magazine"!
Which one!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"A youthful sports story vs. high-octane action...!
T-This is... I cannot possibly choose between them...!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You wanna watch both? You greedy little thing.
Well, you gotta master the Shadow Clone Jutsu like me first!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well then, you choose.
Which one will it be!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I enjoyed the movie 'Gotta Win, Ebisuko'
together with Gold Ship and the others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing them work together to revive a struggling sumo club
and conquer the tournament was deeply moving
and fired up my spirit..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-It was truly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Especially the scene where he beautifully pivots and throws his master at the edge...
The gluttonous, lazy protagonist's growth is just... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh. What's up, McQueen, are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hah... I-I am certainly not crying!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume of the Mejiro family!
Displaying such unseemly emotion is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the heck! Mejiro, Meguro, or blackthroat seaperch, whatever—
when ya wanna cry, you're allowed to cry, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Besides, you saw it too, right? Didn't it move you, seeing them dig deep and push through again and again?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Your chest trembles and tears well in your eyes! Ain't that great?
Livin' without feelin' stuff like that would just be borin'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I... I was simply so moved!
By that movie just now!! ...*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, nice, looking so cute～,
keep your eyes right here, plea～se.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Wait!! Stop trying to take a picture!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dwahahaha!
Run・for・it☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good grief!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...A person you just can't bring yourself to hate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I enjoyed the movie 'JAM: The Miracle Magazine'
together with Gold Ship and the others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With sweaty palms watching pinch after pinch unfold,
I spent a thrilling time captivated by a series of flashy, exhilarating action scenes.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *snort*... *snuff*...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I... I... I can't go on anymore...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, Gold Ship-san...?
Why are you huffing and puffing like that...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Jumping out a window on the 48th floor...
Countering throwing knives with kicks...
Grinding along roller coaster tracks on a skateboard...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!!
That action was awesome!! My blood is boilinggg!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, p-please be quiet...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Gold Ship-san!?
Please wait, just a moment...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no telling what a hyperactive Gold Ship might do!
Together with Mejiro McQueen, I hurried after her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Gold Ship-san!
Just where on earth have you gone?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! That person's a purse snatcher!
Somebody catch them, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-A purse snatcher!?

text_block_list.name: Purse Snatcher
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!!
Hey, you! Outta my way!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Koooooh... I am the action star Golshi,
forged through training across twenty planets...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: None shall pass!! 'HAH'!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABLAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Good heavens, to think you would knock them flat so brilliantly.
Your momentum truly is not to be underestimated at times...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that feels so refreshing!!
Action movies really are the best~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the applause for her magnificent moves,
Gold Ship laughed boisterously.
